summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for a crucial home clash against New Mills at Hind Heath Road, with both sides sitting on 6 points after three games and looking to climb the table. The fixture promises to be an intense affair given the competitive nature of these two sides, and The Bach will be hoping to make it a winning run as matches come thick and fast over the next 11 days. Kick off is at 7.45pm, so get down to support the team!
